s.note: Ethan's Prague, before it all goes wrong
s.how: Slice a baguette into 16 pieces and spread with butter. Top each with a spoon of potato salad, a fold of ham, a slice of boiled egg, a gherkin slice and parsley.
Fry a few prawn crackers at a time at 190C for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly for 20 minutes, then add 2 tbsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp caraway and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 750ml water, return the beef and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with crusty bread.

w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 50g sugar, 200ml warm milk, 60g butter and 1 egg and prove an hour. Wrap strips around foil-covered rolling pins, roll in cinnamon sugar and chopped walnuts and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Slide off and fill with 300ml whipped cream.

d.how: Chill four 500ml bottles of Czech pilsner. Pour hard into heavy glasses so a thick, creamy head forms, then let it settle. This message will self-destruct.
